## Hi, I'm Xueying! Nice to meet you!

You can also call me Sheila. I'm studying digital marketing at Cal Poly
Pomona. Before that, I studied Economics and Book & Media Studies at the
University of Toronto in Canada.

I've worked on SEO content, social media planning, and competitor research
during my internships. I'm now learning how to use R, SQL, and Quarto to
work with marketing data and share what I find.

## Where I'd Like to Go

I'd like to work in marketing analytics, especially in search and content.
My SEO internship got me interested in questions like why some pages
attract visitors while others lose traffic. I want to get better at using
data to answer those questions and decide what to try next.

## Skills I'm Building On

- **SEO and research:** Keyword research, content briefs, competitor research,
  backlink outreach, and internal links. I've used Ahrefs, Similarweb, Semrush, and WordPress.
- **Content:** Social post planning, creator research, and creative briefs;
  Canva and CapCut for visual content.
- **Learning now:** Cleaning and plotting data in R, writing SQL queries,
  planning GA4 events, and building Quarto reports and dashboards.
- **Working with others:** Excel, PowerPoint, Docs, and Slides.
